title: Practice: Lead Diagonal Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner identified the clip as a diagonal elbow (Thai: Sok Chieng, ศอกเฉียง); the move was added to the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Lead Diagonal Elbow) and its cues, mistakes and next come from there. Footage: the owner's clip 8 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p8.mp4; three reps facing the camera, the turned-away part left out.

props.hookSub: Lead diagonal elbow. Sok Chieng. 20 seconds.

cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "Elbows land at hugging range. Step in, then throw."

cues.text: Cut down and across at an angle
cues.label: DOWN & ACROSS
cues.say: Coach: "High to low, across the face. That angle is what cuts."

cues.text: Strike with the tip, hip behind it
cues.label: THE TIP
cues.say: Coach: "The point of the elbow, and turn the hip into it."

watch.fix: Short and tight from the guard
watch.label: WIND-UP
watch.say: Coach: "A big wind-up tells them it's coming. It leaves from where your hand already is."

props.alias: ศอกเฉียง · SOK CHIENG
